$comment: Test fixture exercising all fields of the jewish-succession extension

mezonotDetails.duration: Until the youngest daughter reaches the age of majority or marries
mezonotDetails.notes: Mezonot maintenance obligation for unmarried daughters from the estate, per Shulchan Aruch Choshen Mishpat

bekhorRules.notes: Firstborn son entitled to pi shnayim (double share) of estate assets held at time of death, per Bava Batra 122b

halachicWitnessValidity.notes: Shomer Shabbat male witness, unrelated to any party; confirmed valid by the Beth Din

halachicWitnessValidity.disqualificationReason: Relative of the testator within prohibited degrees
halachicWitnessValidity.notes: Brother-in-law of the deceased; disqualified under halachic witness rules per Choshen Mishpat 33:1

kinyanDetails.notes: Kinyan sudar performed using a handkerchief in the presence of two kosher witnesses at the Beth Din of London

bequestClassifications.notes: Gift inter vivos (matanah) of the Golders Green property to eldest son, executed with kinyan
Halachic inheritance (yerusha) of remaining estate assets per Torah law succession order

notes: Estate of an Orthodox Jewish man domiciled in London. Halachic will (tzavaah) executed alongside a civil will to ensure both halachic and English law compliance. Beth Din of London supervised the process.

x-inherit-ketubah.value: Ketubah registered at the London Beth Din, dated 1998-06-14, stipulating obligations to surviving wife

x-inherit-halachic-yerusha.value: Torah-mandated succession applied; bekhor receives double share of assets in existence at death
